name: Counselor
_comment_depends_on: M16 talks a student through their report card, so it reads the report (M06)
and what the platform knows about them (M04). It needs M06 to have anything
to say; without M04 it still talks, without the goal, the drive or the trend.
M11 gives the counselor a face and a voice, in the browser; without it the
episode is read in the browser's voice, or as text.
Override any base_url without editing this file: M06_BASE_URL=http://...
